notes:
Account overview: Borealis builds an internal code+knowledge search platform used by engineering and SRE teams. Primary product is a code intelligence portal with cross-repo search, ‘semantic jump-to-definition’, and automated code-review assistants. They ingest monorepos + private packages (git + artifact storage).

Scale & ingestion: planning ~40–60M dense vectors (1536 dim) initially, expecting steady growth + nightly delta refreshes; full reindex window ~48–72h currently. They emphasized frequent re-indexing of hot repos (hourly deltas for critical services).

Performance targets: top-10 retrieval latency <= 200ms (p95) for code search queries, tail latency important for dev experience. Throughput: baseline 300 qps with bursts to 1k qps during engineering peak. Cost target: <$0.002/query (embeddings + sparse hybrid + rerank amortized).

Reranking requirements: hybrid flow preferred: ANN to fetch top-200, then cross-encoder rerank top-10 (GPU acceleration for cross-encoder). Must support configurable rerank thresholds to trade cost vs. quality. Quote from CTO: "We can't sacrifice recall for millisecond wins — precision on top results is critical to developer trust."

Security & compliance: strict SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, audit logging with immutable trails, KMS integration for keys, EU/NA data residency options. They will require SOC2-type evidence and an architecture review for on-prem deployment. Also retention policy: 7 years for audit traces, configurable retention for embeddings.

Operational needs: canary rollouts, model pinning/versions, autoscaling of embedding and rerank pools, and cost breakdown per route. They asked about quantized model profiles for cheaper rerank (INT8/FP16) and Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Procurement notes: legal has flagged data residency clause; procurement prefers 12–18 month committed capacity for Dedicated. POC goal: demonstrate 50M vector ingest + nightly delta updates, p95 latency <200ms, and run rerank cross-encoder on dedicated GPU pool.

Stated blockers: legal/residency SLA, need benchmark on their real corpora, SAML integration timeline (vendor side), and budget committee sign-off.
